SQL_wide: SELECT cr.tdocNumber,sp.specNumber FROM CR cr JOIN rel_MODIFIES m ON m.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=m.dst_id WHERE substr(sp.specNumber,1,4)='38.5' ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 5
SQL_raw_record: SELECT json_extract(a.properties_json,'$.tdocNumber'),json_extract(b.properties_json,'$.specNumber') FROM edge e JOIN _node_record a ON a.node_id=e.src_id JOIN _node_record b ON b.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE e.rel_type='MODIFIES' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(a.labels_json) WHERE value='CR') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(b.labels_json) WHERE value='Spec') AND substr(json_extract(b.properties_json,'$.specNumber'),1,4)='38.5' ORDER BY json_extract(a.properties_json,'$.tdocNumber') DESC LIMIT 5
